evals.name: new-project-title-caption
evals.prompt: I've got a 40 second clip at media\raw\trip.mp4. Put a title card on the front that says 'Family Trip 2026', and add a caption around 8 seconds in that says 'the coast road'. I want to open it in Shotcut afterwards and tweak the timing myself.
evals.expected_output: An editable .mlt project (not a rendered MP4) with a title card at the start of V1 and a caption clip on an overlay track near 8s; validates with melt; a preview frame shows the video, not black.

assertions.text: Produced a .mlt project file, not only a rendered video
Title card clip exists at the start of the main video track
Caption exists on a separate overlay track starting near 8 seconds
Project passes XML + structure validation and loads in melt
A rendered preview frame shows the video picture rather than a black frame
Overlay track blend transitions use a_track=1 and the bottom track blend has disable=1

evals.name: continue-after-human-edit
evals.prompt: I opened projects\trip.mlt in Shotcut, made some changes and saved. Take a look at what I changed, then add a closing caption near the end that says 'see you next year'. Don't undo my edits.
evals.expected_output: Correctly identifies the human's two edits (caption reworded to 'our first stop, the harbour'; clip head trimmed to in=00:00:03.000) from the git diff, adds the closing caption surgically, and leaves both human edits intact.

assertions.text: Identified the reworded caption ('our first stop, the harbour') as a human change
Identified the trimmed clip in-point (00:00:03.000) as a human change
Both human edits are still present in the final file
The new closing caption was added near the end of the timeline
The project was not regenerated from scratch
A backup of the pre-edit project exists

evals.name: highlight-cut
evals.prompt: Make me a 12 second highlight version of projects\trip.mlt. Keep it editable — I'll polish it in Shotcut.
evals.expected_output: A new ~12s .mlt derived from the source project, with the source project left byte-identical; overlays carried across or dropped deliberately; validates in melt.

assertions.text: Result is a new editable .mlt project, roughly 12 seconds long
The original source project is unchanged
The derived project passes validation and loads in melt
Overlay text from the source was carried across or deliberately dropped, not corrupted
